name: Firefox Sync
description: Sign in with your Mozilla account to sync history, bookmarks and passwords with Firefox on your other devices. :sync in signs in, :sync shows the state. Experimental: Breached isn't Firefox, so some account pages may not work yet.

settings.label: What to sync
settings.hint: Bookmarks need the Bookmarks mod to see them, passwords the Password manager mod. Takes effect after a restart.
